task: Fix __spreadArray when the source is array-like but explicitly non-concat-spreadable. It should append the source elements rather than the source object itself. Keep the CommonJS and ES module helper implementations consistent.

commands: const assert=require('assert'),fs=require('fs'); async function main(){const modules=[require('./tslib.js'),await import('data:text/javascript;base64,'+Buffer.from(fs.readFileSync('tslib.es6.js','utf8')).toString('base64'))]; for(const t of modules){const source={0:'a',1:'b',length:2,[Symbol.isConcatSpreadable]:false}; for (const pack of [false,true]) {assert.deepStrictEqual(t.__spreadArray([],source,pack),['a','b']);const array=['a','b'];array[Symbol.isConcatSpreadable]=false;assert.deepStrictEqual(t.__spreadArray(['z'],array,pack),['z','a','b']);assert.deepStrictEqual(t.__spreadArray([],{length:0,[Symbol.isConcatSpreadable]:false},pack),[]);} assert.deepStrictEqual(t.__spreadArray(['z'],[1,2],false),['z',1,2]); assert.deepStrictEqual(t.__spreadArray([],[],true),[]); const sparse=[]; sparse.length=2; const packed=t.__spreadArray([],sparse,true); assert.strictEqual(packed.length,2); assert(0 in packed && 1 in packed);}} main().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)});
